description: Live quote for one market (ticker, ins_ id, slug or a bet in words): each side's bid and ask in cents ($1 contracts), yes_pct, no_pct, spread, status, close, game_state; buy_for_yes and buy_for_no name an instrument's ticker side. contracts or stake_dollars adds cost and payout. Signed out: an instrument's Kalshi price (signed_in: false).

contracts.description: Size you are weighing: adds estimated_cost_dollars and venue_fee_est_dollars.

stake_dollars.description: Adds stake, contracts and payout per side.

ticker.description: A Kalshi ticker, instrument id or slug. ref and instrument_id are the same.

title: Quote one market
